data.title: 帕瓦 · 涩谷街头的霸道迈步
data.description: 涩谷繁忙的十字路口斑马线上，身穿宽松牛仔夹克与短裤的帕瓦双手叉腰大摇大摆迈步，高昂着下颌，吸引了整条街所有行人的目光。
data.action: striding with swagger, hands on hips, chin raised high, proud smirk
data.lighting: bright midday city sunlight reflecting off surrounding billboards
data.promptProse: Striding confidently across a bustling Shibuya crosswalk, Power sports an oversized denim jacket and shorts, hands on hips with an unapologetic, proud swagger.
data.animaCaption: Power strutting proudly across a busy city crosswalk in casual streetwear.
